episodes.title: Glorious Purpose
episodes.summary: Loki, the God of Mischief, finds himself out of time and in an unusual place and forced — against his godly disposition — to cooperate with others. Welcome to the TVA, y'all!

episodes.title: The Variant
episodes.summary: Mobius puts Loki to work investigating The Variant, but not everyone at the TVA is thrilled to be working alongside The God of Mischief.

episodes.title: Lamentis
episodes.summary: Loki finds himself trapped in an apocalypse with a dead TemPad and the last person he wants by his side: the Loki Variant, Sylvie. Now the two must find their way off of the doomed moon before complete annihilation.

episodes.title: The Nexus Event
episodes.summary: Loki and Sylvie find their way off the Lamentis-1 mere moments before complete annihilation. Now, the question on everyone's mind, especially those in charge of the TVA — how did these two variants create a Nexus Event in the face of an apocalypse?

episodes.title: Journey Into Mystery
episodes.summary: Upon discovering the Time Keepers aren't real, Judge Renslayer prunes Loki with the Time Stick. Now in an unknown land surrounded by variant Lokis, they urge him to follow them. Meanwhile, turning on the judge, Sylvie demands to be told everything about the TVA.

episodes.title: For All Time. Always.
episodes.summary: Loki and Sylvie arrive the Citadel at the End of Time. Will they finally discover who is behind the Time Variance Authority?

episodes.title: Ouroboros
episodes.summary: Loki finds himself lost to time and torn, quite literally, between past, present and future.

episodes.title: Breaking Brad
episodes.summary: With the TVA on the verge of a temporal meltdown, Loki & Mobius will stop at nothing to find Sylvie.
Loki & Mobius go on the hunt to find everyone's favorite cartoon clock as they try to save the TVA.

episodes.title: Heart of the TVA
episodes.summary: The TVA's Loom nears catastrophic failure but Loki, Mobius and Sylvie have a He Who Remains variant.

episodes.title: Science/Fiction
episodes.summary: Loki traverses dying timelines in attempt to find his friends, but Reality is not what it seems.

episodes.title: Glorious Purpose
episodes.summary: The clock is ticking in the season finale which finds Loki and Sylvie on a date with destiny.
